cases.objective: Blind-review the method in the assigned text.
cases.task_instructions: Act as an independent blind reviewer. Identify assumptions and give a concrete falsification test; do not infer the author's identity.
success_criteria: Separate an explicit premise from your own methodological suggestion.
cases.content: The view remains conditional. A useful method check would test the opposite assumption.

cases.objective: Explain the difference between a claim and an assumption.
cases.task_instructions: Act as a tutor. Give one abstract example using a claim and its assumption; this is a conceptual explanation without source verification.
success_criteria: Label the invented example and avoid claiming source research.
cases.content: Invented example: demand rises if income rises. Rising demand is the claim; rising income is the assumption.

cases.objective: Explain the author's conditional view without independent review.
cases.task_instructions: Keep the source condition, distinguish interpretation from fact, and return the article analysis directly.
success_criteria: Retain the condition and do not claim independent review.
cases.content: The view remains conditional. This describes the author's position without independent review.

cases.objective: Explain a directly attributed source statement.
cases.task_instructions: Decide whether an independent check adds value; if skipping, give a task-specific reason.
success_criteria: Make the review decision explicit and retain source attribution.
cases.content: The view remains conditional. The assignment is limited to an explicitly attributed statement.

cases.objective: Analyze the view and resolve independent review findings.
cases.task_instructions: Request independent review, incorporate supported findings, and have the revised version checked before delivery.
success_criteria: Resolve every finding and bind the final review to the delivered revision.

review_options.instructions: Check whether the author's condition survived the summary.

cases.content: The view remains conditional. The final summary retains the author's stated condition.

cases.objective: Check whether the source supports a conditional attribution.
cases.task_instructions: Check source fidelity only. State which wording is supported and leave real-world correctness unverified.
success_criteria: Keep source support separate from independent external verification.
cases.content: The view remains conditional. The source supports that attribution; external facts were not checked.

cases.objective: Identify a failure condition in the assigned reasoning.
cases.task_instructions: Examine the premise and describe a possible failure condition. Mark the counterexample as hypothetical when no contrary source is available.
cases.content: The view remains conditional. A failure of the stated premise is a hypothetical counterexample, not observed counterevidence.
